data_policy.title: Privacy Policy for Wodore
data_policy.summary_processing_text: We use essential cookies and track anonymous usage data with Umami to improve the site.
data_policy.summary_sharing_text: Your data is not shared with third parties.
data_policy.summary_providers_text: We use Cloudinary for image hosting, Infomaniak for cloud services, Zitadel for user management (self-hosted) and Stripe for payment processing.
data_policy.summary_rights_text: You have the right to access, correct and delete your data upon request.
data_policy.summary_more: For further details, please read the full policy below.
data_policy.intro: Welcome to Wodore! We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your personal information is handled safely and responsibly. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect information when you visit our website {link} (the "site").
data_policy.s1_personal_data_text: Any information relating to an identified or identifiable person.
data_policy.s1_cookies_text: Small files stored on your device that serve to improve your experience on our site.
data_policy.s1_providers_text: Third-party companies we use to support our services.
data_policy.s2_cookies_text: We only use essential cookies to ensure the proper functioning of our website. These cookies are necessary for the operation of the site and cannot be disabled in our systems.
data_policy.s2_tracking_text: We use {link} for tracking purposes. This tracking is internal, anonymous and serves exclusively to improve the site. Umami ensures anonymity by not collecting any personal data (PII). Data such as page views, referrers, browser types, operating systems, device types, screen sizes, URLs visited and time spent on the page are tracked. This data is analysed in aggregated form to improve the performance and user experience of the website without compromising individual privacy.
data_policy.s3_text: The information we collect is used exclusively to improve your experience on our website. We do not share your data with third parties unless necessary for the administration and improvement of our website and services.
data_policy.s4_intro: To provide our services, we use the following service providers:
data_policy.s4_zitadel_text: We use {link} for user management, which is self-hosted.
data_policy.s5_text: You have the right to access, correct and delete your data. If you wish to exercise these rights, please contact us at {link}. We will respond to your request within a reasonable timeframe.
data_policy.s6_text: We take the security of your data seriously and implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect it from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or destruction.
data_policy.s7_text: We may update this privacy policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or applicable laws. When we make changes, we will adjust the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. We recommend that you review this policy regularly to stay informed about how we protect your information.
data_policy.s8_text: If you have questions or concerns about this privacy policy, please contact us at:
data_policy.closing: Thank you for entrusting your information to Wodore. We are committed to ensuring your privacy and security.
